evidence: Independent read-only comparison found all 24 inventoried concepts preserved, including protocol and authentication boundaries, validation contracts, safety rules, numerical limits, error behavior, and reference paths, with no new capability claims.

concept_evidence.source: GET https://api.example.com/users/123
concept_evidence.candidate: Direct request examples use `GET https://api.example.com/users/123` with `Accept: application/json`/`X-API-Key`, and JSON `POST https://api.example.com/users` with `Content-Type: application/json` plus name/email.

concept_evidence.source: Validate API responses against expected schemas
concept_evidence.candidate: The canonical response schema requires status `200`, JSON content type, and an object body with required integer `id` and string `name` properties.

concept_evidence.source: The skill supports various assertion types for validating responses
concept_evidence.candidate: Assertions: `status == 200`, `body.name == "John"`, `headers.content-type contains "json"`, `time < 500` milliseconds, `body.items.length >= 10`

concept_evidence.source: Response Metrics:
concept_evidence.candidate: Timing output retains Total `245ms`, DNS `12ms`, TCP `23ms`, TLS `89ms`, TTFB `156ms`, download `34ms`, response size `1.2KB`.

concept_evidence.source: Set up a mock server for testing client applications
concept_evidence.candidate: Mock server example listens on port `8080`; GET `/users` returns status `200` with ID `1`/name `Mock User`; POST returns `201`, `created: true`, and `{{random.uuid}}`.

concept_evidence.source: Connection Errors
concept_evidence.candidate: Report connection, configurable-timeout, authentication, and SSL/TLS errors clearly.

concept_evidence.source: Options to skip certificate validation for testing
concept_evidence.candidate: Certificate validation may be skipped only for testing.

concept_evidence.source: Never hardcode sensitive values like API keys
concept_evidence.candidate: Use environment variables; never hardcode API keys or other sensitive values.

concept_evidence.source: Keep test collections in version control
concept_evidence.candidate: Keep test collections in version control.

concept_evidence.source: Include tests for error conditions, not just happy paths
concept_evidence.candidate: Test failures and edge cases, not only happy paths.

concept_evidence.source: Set reasonable time assertions to catch performance regressions
concept_evidence.candidate: Set reasonable response-time assertions to detect regressions.
